entries.title: An afternoon inside the light
text: Filler entry. Started with sushi at the fish market at an hour that felt illegal, then spent the afternoon walking barefoot through teamLab Planets.
Pick one of the teamLab venues and do it properly rather than rushing both. The water rooms are the part I keep thinking about.

entries.title: Sensoji before the crowds
text: Filler entry. Got to the temple early enough that the shutters on Nakamise Street were still down. Completely different place at 6 AM than at noon.
Walked to Skytree afterwards along the river, which took about twenty minutes and turned out to be the nicest part of the morning.

entries.title: Fuji from the Skytree
text: Filler entry. Clear enough to see Fuji sitting on the horizon like it had been placed there for the photo. Apparently this is rare and we got lucky.
Stayed up there much longer than planned.

entries.title: Sunrise, then a slow day
text: Filler entry. Rock Beach at sunrise is worth the alarm. Sat on the promenade until the heat made it unreasonable, then spent the rest of the day doing almost nothing.
Ended up on MG Road in the evening, mostly browsing.

entries.title: Into the mangroves
text: Filler entry. Two hours south of Pondicherry and suddenly you are in a maze of water channels with trees growing straight out of them.
The boatman knew exactly which turns to take. I would still be in there otherwise.

entries.title: A lagoon the size of a district
text: Filler entry. Booked the boat from the official counter after being waved down four separate times on the road by people who very much did not work there.
Worth it. The lagoon just keeps opening up.

entries.title: The language of stone
text: Filler entry. Tagore said the language of stone surpasses the language of human here, and standing in front of it that stops sounding like a line.
Spent most of the time on the carvings rather than the wheels everyone photographs.

entries.title: Sunset, then the river
text: Filler entry. No two sunsets here are the same, which sounds like something you put on a postcard until you watch a few in a row.
The floating casinos light up on the Mandovi right after. Completely different energy, ten minutes apart.

entries.title: Churches, in the right order
text: Filler entry. Did the Old Goa circuit on the way south. St. Cajetan was the surprise, and it is the one I would go back to.
Check the timings before you go. They are not the same for any two of them.
